name: MELON
aliases: NeRF with Unposed Images in SO(3)
definition: An encoder-decoder-based method that infers a neural representation of a scene from unposed views. It simultaneously trains a CNN encoder that maps images to camera poses in SO(3) and a neural radiance field of the scene. It does not require CNN pre-training and operates ab-initio without pose initialization.
summary: MELON is a differentiable inverse rendering method that jointly optimizes NeRF and camera poses from unposed images using a modulo loss to handle rotational symmetries and avoid local minima.
